text.description_html:
Acorn IHQBP, 30 Inch Iron Art Dummy Strap Bean Tip Hinges

The 30 Inch Iron Art Dummy Strap Bean Tip Hinge is for use with butt hinges. It gives an old world charm to any home door without the need of installing working hinges. This makes The 30 Inch Bean Tip Iron Art Dummy Strap Hinge especially good for use on places where installing working hinges to get the same look would be impractical, such as on a garage door. Made from hand forged iron art using the techniques of the traditional forge, it has a lifetime finish warranty.

Also Available 36 Inch Bean Tip Iron Art Dummy Strap Hinge

Specifications of the Bean Tip Iron Art Dummy Hinges:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Length: 30"
  • Width: 3"
  • Packaged with black finish mounting wood screws.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Sold Individually
